title: Brassica rapa — Lunar LEAF Cosmic Radiation & Redox Decoder (LLGCSS)
description: Cross-species translation of spaceflight transcriptomics, continuous 40 cGy GCR kinetics, and redox variational autoencoders in Brassica rapa (Wisconsin Fast Plants) across 39 factorial RNA-seq libraries (Dose × Genotype × Preservative). Part of the NASA Artemis candidate Lunar LEAF effort by Aubry O'Rourke, Richard Barker et al.
